boundaries: The simulator uses observer-like bounded carrier patches, twelve local port readings, inherited records and repair moves; these scalar port-load moments have no certified geometric-volume or curvature identification.
The fresh uniform {0..4} release law and replication rule are supplied simulation choices, not derived laws.
A spatial linear-projection residual is not E[y|all inherited records] subtracted from y, and is not an ensemble martingale innovation.
No cross-scale spatial covariance, Fourier k mapping, radiation transfer or primordial amplitude/tilt is inferred.
No CMB observations or fitted cosmological inputs are consumed.

Exact replay is conditional on the producer RNG semantics; archived native runs did not save fresh-array digests. An independent parent-variance receipt checks every L8 unshuffled chain at all eight scales.
Shuffled mode permutes the inherited field before generating the measured inherited predictor. It removes spatial structure but need not give response_b=0; it is not a target-uncorrelated control.
